name: Scharnhorst — Atlantic-bow battle fit
axes: right-handed: X bow-positive; Y up; Z transverse
configuration: Post-1939 Atlantic bow. Two forward triple 283-mm turrets (B raised), one aft triple; one funnel; four twin and four single 150-mm secondary mounts. Small AA and electronics are representative inferred 1943 detail.
accuracy: Independent recognition-informed exterior for the named class and battle demonstration. Major hull dimensions and weapons fit are documented; hull sections, bridge surfaces, underwater body, deck fittings and precise refit detail are inferred. Not a surveyed shipyard reconstruction. ONI204 profile informs the connected machinery/shelter deck and after control tiers. Small platform dimensions remain inferred.
geometrySource: New independently authored hull stations and equipment coordinates; no geometry copied or rescaled from an unrelated vessel.
dimensionBasis: Published class dimensions cited in sources; overall length, maximum hull beam and stated load draft.
layoutProvenance: ONI 204 plate 26 plan/profile and plate 31 oblique view: main turret centers, single funnel, stepped forward bridge and after mast measured in longitudinal proportions. Wartime ONI dimensions/armament intelligence is cross-checked against later class records.

sources.title: ONI 204: German Naval Vessels, Scharnhorst BB-2

surfaceProfile.geometryPolicy: Preserve hull loft, fittings and weapon stations. Reduced cylinder and ring tessellation adds at most 3 mm radial error; already coarser original fittings are unchanged. Lossless Float32 vertex indexing preserves UV and hard-normal seams.
